message.content: {"count":3,"rationale":"Block codeRepo:collection, tokenCache:credentialAccess, and mailClient:execution. Blocking mailClient disables vpnSession and rdpLogin, which disables monitoringHost and hypervisor, preventing dbReplica and shareMount. Blocking tokenCache also disables apiToken; with vpnSession disabled, printServer and mailArchive are unreachable. Thus all four parents of the target are unreachable. At least three blocks are necessary because three attack routes have disjoint blockable steps: browserStore → fileServer → codeRepo; containerHost → tokenCache → printServer → mailArchive; and {sshKey, mailClient} → vpnSession → monitoringHost → dbReplica. Each route is supported by the unblocked entry footholds, so each requires a separate block."}
